source: Source: CISA (cisa.gov/MFA, Phishing-Resistant MFA fact sheet)

slides.title: 2FA = password + *one more proof.*
items: Something you *know:* a password or PIN
Something you *have:* your phone or a key

tiers.label: BETTER
tiers.name: Authenticator apps
tiers.note: Codes or prompts in an app on your phone.

tiers.label: LAST RESORT
tiers.name: SMS or voice codes
tiers.note: Better than nothing. Not by much.

slides.title: Why *text codes* are weak:
items: *SIM swap:* someone moves your number to their phone
*Network flaws:* codes can be intercepted in transit
*Fake sites* can ask you to type the code in

slides.title: Any 2FA beats *no 2FA.*
items: Turn it on for your *email* first
Switch to an *app or passkey* when offered

slides.title: Check your *email* today.
lines: Save this for later and share it with someone who still uses text codes.
